title: SarcasTraps: Effect of Sarcasm on Turkish Hate Speech Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.16957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard hate speech detection datasets often emphasize explicit harmful language, but directed harm can also be expressed indirectly, without clearly hateful wording. Sarcasm is one such form of indirect expression, as it can convey harmful intent through mock praise, exaggeration, humor, or apparent politeness. In this paper, we introduce SarcasTraps, a targeted external test set for analyzing the effect of sarcasm on Turkish hate speech detection. SarcasTraps contains 479 entries annotated along two dimensions: hate speech and sarcasm. We train classifiers using BERTurk and XLM-RoBERTa on two existing Turkish hate speech datasets and evaluate them on SarcasTraps, using it strictly as an external test set. We also evaluate GPT-4.1 and Llama-3.3-70B in a zero-shot setting on SarcasTraps. Results show that sarcasm substantially affects hate speech detection. Fine-tuned encoder models lose recall on sarcastic hate, while zero-shot LLMs

translated_title: SarcasTraps：讽刺对土耳其语仇恨言论检测的影响
translated_abstract: 标准的仇恨言论检测数据集通常强调显性的有害语言，但针对性伤害也可以通过间接方式表达，而不使用明显仇恨的措辞。讽刺正是这样一种间接表达形式，它可以通过假意称赞、夸张、幽默或表面上的礼貌来传达有害意图。本文介绍了SarcasTraps，这是一个用于分析讽刺对土耳其语仇恨言论检测影响的针对性外部测试集。SarcasTraps包含479条数据，并沿两个维度进行标注：仇恨言论和讽刺。我们使用BERTurk和XLM-RoBERTa在两个现有的土耳其语仇恨言论数据集上训练分类器，并在SarcasTraps上对其进行评估，严格将其用作外部测试集。我们还在零样本设置下于SarcasTraps上评估了GPT-4.1和Llama-3.3-70B。结果表明，讽刺会显著影响仇恨言论检测。微调的编码器模型在检测讽刺性仇恨言论时召回率下降，而零样本大语言模型（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文构建了SarcasTraps——一个包含479条数据、沿仇恨言论与讽刺双维度标注的土耳其语外部测试集，并通过实验揭示讽刺会显著干扰仇恨言论检测：微调的编码器模型在讽刺性仇恨言论上召回率下降，零样本大语言模型同样受到影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SarcasTraps, a 479-entry Turkish external test set annotated along both hate speech and sarcasm dimensions, showing that sarcasm substantially degrades hate speech detection—fine-tuned encoder models lose recall on sarcastic hate, while zero-shot LLMs are also affected.
